desc:
⚠️[VERY EARLY ALPHA, EXPECT BUGS AND UNFINISHED GAMEPLAY]⚠️
🖥️ The game is optimized and best played on Computers/Laptops

⚙️ Welcome to Noob Factory!

Click to earn cash, upgrade your factory, and spawn an ever-growing army of noobs to fight experimental dummies in the battle zone! Waves get harder, upgrades get weirder, and your factory gets bigger.

💰 How to Expand Your Factory ⚔️
- Click the Clicker Screen to earn cash
- Buy upgrades to generate money faster
- Purchase Noob Spawners to deploy different noob types
- Defeat Dummies to earn even more cash
- Climb the global leaderboard and become the BEST

🔁 Noob Spawners automatically produce noobs, just sit back and watch!
💥 26+ unique Noob types to unlock and experiment with
😈 Infinite waves with 46+ Enemy types
📈 Endless growth and expansion!
🏭 Earn money even while offline
